import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,sys,json,os,hashlib
p=Path.cwd();pins=json.loads((p/'PINS.json').read_text())
def write(n,s):subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(p/'write_lane.py'),n],input=s,text=True,capture_output=True,check=True)
names=['indexedEdges','indexedEdges_matching','indexedEdges_covered','indexedEdges_injective','indexed_switch_not_ur']
write('src/URMatchingEmbeddedAxioms.lean','module\nimport URMatchingEmbeddedSwitch\n'+''.join('#print axioms URMatching.'+n+'\n' for n in names))
env=dict(os.environ,LEAN_PATH=os.pathsep.join([str(p/'build')]+pins['upstream_lean_paths']),LEAN_NUM_THREADS='1')
r=subprocess.run([pins['lean_bin'],'-j1','-M3500','-DwarningAsError=true',str(p/'src/URMatchingEmbeddedAxioms.lean')],env=env,text=True,capture_output=True)
print(r.stdout,r.stderr,'exit',r.returncode);write('audit/embedded-scoped-axioms.txt',r.stdout+r.stderr);assert r.returncode==0
state=json.loads((p/'results/338806.json').read_text());state['strict_green_modules'].append('URMatchingEmbeddedSwitch');state['paid_this_lane'].append('Embedded partial-matching permutation switch in arbitrary finite vertex type; exact range coverage and injective edge-set representation. Cycle-to-permutation and enumeration of arbitrary matching still unpaid.')
state['last_compile']={'label':'r4_embedded_compile_026','exit':0};state['last_checker']={'label':'r4_embedded_kernel_027','exit':0}
for n in ['src/URMatchingEmbeddedSwitch.lean','build/URMatchingEmbeddedSwitch.olean','r4_embedded_compile_026.output.txt','r4_embedded_compile_026.receipt.json','r4_embedded_kernel_027.output.txt','r4_embedded_kernel_027.receipt.json','audit/embedded-scoped-axioms.txt']:state['new_evidence'][n]=hashlib.sha256((p/n).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
write('results/338806.json',json.dumps(state,indent=2))
for n in ['SUMMARY.md','CHECKPOINT.md']:write(n,(p/n).read_text()+'\nURMatchingEmbeddedSwitch compile r4_embedded_compile_026 exit0; checker r4_embedded_kernel_027 exit0; five scoped declarations only permitted trio.
